name: ailabel
need: Mark content a model generated, with an icon and a word, and a toggletip that explains it

--ds-ailabel-height.description: the label at md (4px per size step, 2px less per density step)

--ds-ailabel-color.description: the tonal label's icon and word

--ds-ailabel-tip-width.description: the widest the explainer grows (never wider than the window)

physical..ds-ailabel__tip: inset: script coordinates: --ds-ailabel-x from the left of the viewport

ripple..ds-ailabel: a label-sized toggle inside a line of text, like an inline link: the state layer is the feedback
